prompts.name: combat-1
prompts.prompt: Create production sprite sheet for approved Eide fighting-game model. Reference1 contains both approved skins: use ONLY LEFT navy-shirt navy-trouser brown-shoe messenger-bag employee-lanyard skin. Preserve exact face, build, outfit, no redesign. Reference2 Gut atlas is rendering style only. EXACT 6 columns x4 rows =24 evenly spaced full-body sprites, each inside own equal cell with generous margin and same character scale. Transparent background, no text, no glow, no shadows. All face RIGHT at three-quarter side camera. Row1: ready guard; extended lead punch; extended cross punch; extended finishing hook punch; high heavy kick; heavy straight punch. Row2: crouching punch; airborne kick; blocking guard; recoiling hit; lying knocked down; celebrating arms raised. Row3: jump crouch anticipation; ascending jump knees bent; descending fall; landing crouch; forward dash lean; backward dash retreat. Row4: holding washing machine at chest; arms extended releasing heavy object forward; lifting washing machine above head; releasing heavy object diagonally upward; crouch guard; rising from floor. Crisp dark outlines, limited cel shading and pixel-edged arcade sprite exactly like approved model. Never omit leg, never duplicate figures within cell.

prompts.name: walk-1
prompts.prompt: Eide approved fighter walking animation sprite sheet. Reference contains two skins use ONLY LEFT navy work uniform, messenger bag and badge. Same exact person and crisp outlined arcade game sprite style. Exactly FOUR columns TWO rows, eight frames, uniform equal cells. Side view facing RIGHT. Natural complete TWO-LEG WALK CYCLE. Top row frames1-4: LEFT/near leg heel forward contact with RIGHT/far leg back toe push; near leg lowers taking weight; far/right foot lifts passing underneath hip; far/right knee swings forward. Bottom row frames5-8: RIGHT/far leg heel FORWARD contact with LEFT/near leg BACK toe push, near/left foot lifts and passes beneath hip, left knee swings FORWARD, ready to return to first contact. Same head height and body proportions all frames, full body shoes included with margins, soles baseline consistent, no extra people no text no grid lines, transparent background.
